1.consolidated_definition: publ. Pancarta publicitaria. Anuncio grande generalmente en tela, cartón duro o plástico que se coloca en el exterior. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. 1.en_consolidated_definition: Publicity banner. A large advertisement generally placed outdoors on fabric, hard cardboard, or plastic. Crude anglicism, frequent. A corporate incentive: once a mercenary relationship is established between the writer and their adoptive company, this could exploit their reputation as a benevolent institution by reproducing the smiling face of the adopted writer on t-shirts, bumper stickers, or billboards thirty feet high, accompanied by phrases such as: proud sponsor of the literary endeavors of…
